design_principle: Define behavior, reference semantics and adversarial dimensions first. Existing tests are preservation evidence only.

public_contracts.invariant: Names, dtype, shape, ordered typed cells, null policy, errors and arithmetic semantics match the documented API.
public_contracts.oracle: Independent hand-computed or scalar reference; external oracle only with semantics pinned.

storage_ownership.invariant: Views and copies preserve cells, offsets and lifetime; mutation cannot corrupt aliases; resource releases occur exactly once.
storage_ownership.oracle: Value checks plus identity, aliasing and release counters where ownership is the contract.

kernel_equivalence.invariant: Each specialized kernel agrees with an independent scalar model over its eligibility domain and fallback boundaries.
kernel_equivalence.oracle: Independent scalar implementation; compare full typed outputs and errors, never only sums.

planner_correctness.invariant: Rewrites preserve values, schema, ordering, errors and required dependencies.
planner_correctness.oracle: Optimize on/off with executor fixed, plus independent public-contract expectations.

execution_modes.invariant: Deterministic plans agree across batch, worker, streaming, materializing and available backend modes; cancellation releases resources.
execution_modes.oracle: Same plan and fixed optimizer across modes, checked against independent expected results.

interchange.invariant: Typed import/export preserves complete cells, null distinctions, schema, offsets and ownership according to format contracts.
interchange.oracle: Explicit typed expected data plus independent producer/consumer; roundtrip alone is insufficient.

contracts.statement: Projection, slice and take preserve specified row order, including duplicate indices; slicing clips according to the API.

contracts.statement: Keep exactly the rows whose predicate is valid and true, in input order.

contracts.statement: Arithmetic, comparisons and numeric transforms follow declared types, per-row overflow, floating-point policies and null propagation.

contracts.statement: Null, NaN, Boolean logic and conditionals obey their distinct documented semantics.

strict float grammar and nonfinite/range policy

coverage_strategy: Explicit contract examples first, systematic interactions second, seeded shrinkable random cases third. Required obligations remain visible when unimplemented.
completion_rule: Every contract has independent expected behavior, appropriate oracle, all required dimensions and sensitive mutation/lifecycle checks. Test counts and parity with a previous suite are not completion criteria.
